title: First Aorist Verbs

content.text: In English we have two ways of forming the past tense.

items: Add the "ed" suffix to the word: I [[u]]laugh[[/u]] at Elliott's jokes (present). I [[u]]laughed[[/u]] at Elliott's jokes (past).
Change the root of the verb: Zach [[u]]runs[[/u]] down the court (present). Zach [[u]]ran[[/u]] down the court (past).

content.text: Like English, Greek forms the past in two ways.
The first aorist is formed off the present stem with an augment and a suffixed σα.
The second aorist is built from a different aorist root which adds endings identical to the imperfect.

The aorist is the most frequently used tense in the New Testament. Both the first and second aorists are usually translated as a simple past (e.g., He came...). However, they may sometimes be translated by the English perfect (e.g., "has spoken").
It should be noted that the Greek present tense may sometimes be translated in the past tense ([[u]]historical present[[/u]]).
The aorist is used for undefined action in the past (e.g. He loosed). The imperfect is used for continuous action in the past (e.g. He was loosing).
First aorists use the present stem to which an augment is prefixed and an σα is affixed along with the pronominal endings of the first, second and third persons.
The first aorist is built from the first aorist verb stem. It is preceded by an "ε" augment and followed by secondary endings like the imperfect.

topics.title: Augments

content.text: Aorist Augments = Imperfect Augments
The augment is added in 4 ways:

items.text:
before vowels the augment contracts with the vowel according to the following rules:
α + ε = η      ε + ε = η      ο + ε = ω
ει + ε = ῃ     αι + ε = ῃ     οι + ε = ῳ
αυ + ε = ηυ    ευ + ε = ηυ

below.label: Contraction Examples
below._disclosure: C1: chart payload behind an in-text "Examples" link -> accordion. Clips are chapter 12's l_ex1-10, duplicated into the CHAPT_15 pack by the ISO (Stage 6).

items.text:
Compound verbs with prepositions ending in a consonant: insert the augment between the prepositional prefix and the verb stem.
ἐκβάλλω becomes ἐξέβαλον

Compound verbs with prepositions ending in a vowel: the final vowel of the preposition is dropped and the ε augment inserted in its place.
ἀποκτείνω becomes ἀπέκτεινα

topics.title: Ending Transformations

content.text: The sigma ending is added in basically the same way as the sigma was added for future tense verbs.

parts.text: (τ, δ, θ) + σ  drops the dental

content._disclosure: C3 in-chart triggers (3.3): Palatals, Labials and Dentals are the hot text, each opening its own popup; they keep their existing appearance (blue in the original), no green underline.

content.text: With [[link:liquids]]liquids[[/link]] (λ and ρ) and nasals (μ and ν) ofen the sigma is dropped and the preceding vowel in the stem is changed.
These transformations are not always predictable.  Thus it is necessary to learn the aorist for each verb.

content.text: Palatals are sounds like the "k" in "kitchen" which are made with the tongue and palate.
Labials are sounds like the "b" in "better" which are made with the lips.
Dentals are sounds like the "t" in "top" which are made with the teeth and tongue.
Liquids are smoothly flowing sounds like the "l" in "last" which are made with the air flowing smoothly out of the mouth.

items.greek: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν παραβολαῖς πολλά καὶ
options: and we were teaching them many things in parables and were saying to them
and he was teaching them many things in parables and was saying to them
and they were teaching him many things in parables and were saying to him
items.answer: and he was teaching them many things in parables and was saying to them

items.greek: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον αὐτοῦ
options: and I sent him to his home
and he sent him to his home
and they sent him to his home
items.answer: and he sent him to his home

items.greek: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ φαρισαῖοι
options: Therefore when Jesus knew that the Pharisee heard
Therefore when the Pharisees knew that Jesus heard
Therefore when Jesus knew that the Pharisees heard
items.answer: Therefore when Jesus knew that the Pharisees heard

items.greek: καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὡς φωνὴν
options: and I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters
and he heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters
and they heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters
items.answer: and I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters

items.greek: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς
options: And Mary remained with her about three months
And they remained with Mary about three months
And he remained with Mary about three months
items.answer: And Mary remained with her about three months

items.greek: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ
options: and all came to the crowd and he taught them
and all the crowd came to him and was taught by him
and all the crowd came to him and he taught them
items.answer: and all the crowd came to him and he taught them

items.greek: ἔτι ἕνα εἶχεν υἱὸν ἀγαπητόν: ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν
options: Yet they had one, a beloved son, they sent him last to them
Yet he had one, a beloved son, he sent him last to them
Yet he had one, a beloved son, they sent him last to him
items.answer: Yet he had one, a beloved son, he sent him last to them

items.greek: καὶ ἤκουσαν φωνῆς μεγάλης ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
options: and he heard a loud voice from heaven
and I heard a loud voice from heaven
and they heard a loud voice from heaven
items.answer: and they heard a loud voice from heaven

options: You (pl) heard "Eye for eye and tooth for tooth"
You (sg) heard "Eye for eye and tooth for tooth"
They heard "Eye for eye and tooth for tooth"
items.answer: You (pl) heard "Eye for eye and tooth for tooth"

items.greek: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς
options: but according to your mercy you saved us
but according to his mercy you saved us
but according to his mercy he saved us
items.answer: but according to his mercy he saved us

items.greek: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν
options: And they were teaching in their synagogues
And he was teaching in their synagogues
And we were teaching in their synagogues
items.answer: And he was teaching in their synagogues

items.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν υἱὸν εἰς τὸν
options: For God did not send the son into the world to judge the world
For God's son was not sent into the world to judge the world
For he sent God's son into the world to judge the world
items.answer: For God did not send the son into the world to judge the world

items.greek: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν, Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι
options: They heard that I said to you, "I go away and I will come to you"
He heard that I said to you, "I go away and I will come to you"
You heard that I said to you, "I go away and I will come to you"
items.answer: You heard that I said to you, "I go away and I will come to you"

items.greek: Κύριε, ἤκουσα ἀπὸ πολλῶν περὶ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς
options: Lord, I heard from many about this man
Lord, you heard from many about this man
Lord, they heard from many about this man
items.answer: Lord, I heard from many about this man

items.greek: καὶ παρ' αὐτῷ ἔμειναν τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην
options: and he stayed with him that day
and they stayed with him that day
and you stayed with him that day
items.answer: and they stayed with him that day

items.greek: ἐγὼ πάντοτε ἐδίδαξα ἐν συναγωγῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ
options: We always taught in synagogues and in the temple
I always taught in synagogues and in the temple
They always taught in their synagogues and in the temple
items.answer: I always taught in synagogues and in the temple

items.greek: ἀπέστειλεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν
options: He sent his son, a propitiation for our sins
You sent your son, a propitiation for our sins
I sent my son, a propitiation for your sins
items.answer: He sent his son, a propitiation for our sins

items.greek: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε
options: Children, it is the last hour, and just as we heard that anti-Christ comes

items.answer: Children, it is the last hour, and just as you heard that anti-Christ comes

for all things that I have heard from my father
for all things that they have heard from my father

whom God raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses

items.greek: ἀπέστειλαν οὖν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν

Therefore the sisters sent to him
Therefore we sent the sisters to you
items.answer: Therefore the sisters sent to him

items.greek: Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς

They heard from the law that the Christ remains forever

options: We wrote to you in the letter
